result.summary: No critical blockers are visible; the page appears functional overall. The main concerns are minor layout/content polish issues around horizontally scrolling content being clipped and a strange “-0%” badge.

issues.description: The rightmost items in horizontally scrolling sections are hard-clipped at the screen edge, including the third “Fastest near you” restaurant whose name is cut off as “Trattoria Piccol…”.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordance such as peek spacing, edge fade, arrows, or ensure partially visible cards have enough margin so truncation looks intentional.

issues.description: A promotional badge shows “-0%”, which reads as a meaningless or broken discount value.
issues.suggestion: Remove the badge when the discount is 0%, or replace it with a valid offer label such as “Free delivery” or an actual percentage.

issues.description: The lower “Popular right now” card is cut off by the bottom of the viewport in this static view, making the page look unfinished if perceived as a fixed screen rather than scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: This is likely expected for scrollable mobile content; if not, adjust spacing/card height or provide a clearer continuation cue.
